question: What obligation of transmission is fulfilled when a particular practice concerning the soul is declared to a specific recipient?
premises: This practice concerning the soul is told to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
The declaration fulfills the act of transmission to that recipient.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The details of the practice are not given in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
